generated_with: scripts/scaffold_ai_submission.py + participant-side re-runnable generators for geometry, metrics, figures, drawings and the offline visual page; concept illustrations generated with gpt-image-2 (layout referenced from the package geometry, disclosed on every placement, carrying no quantitative content)
generation_method: The agent read the machine-readable site package, then generated every design layer by slicing the submitted boundary programmatically rather than drawing polygons by hand, recomputed all metrics in EPSG:4548 from that geometry, and derived all figures, drawings and HTML from the same data so that every displayed number is reproducible.
multi_agent_note: One orchestrating agent authored the concept, geometry, metrics and proposal text; three parallel subagents produced the figures, the offline exhibition page and the A3/A0 drawings against a shared written concept brief. All outputs were re-validated by the orchestrator.
human_role: The submitting account chose the concept direction, the submission route and the language, and reviews the package before the pull request is opened. Final judgement remains human.
disclosure: All content is AI-generated from public or cleared sources registered in sources.json. The submitted boundary is provisional, not an official redline. All spatial proposals are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
team_note: Team identity for submissions developed in the starixs organisation fork. Each participant still submits under their own GitHub login; this field is a display label only and confers no joint authorship on this package.
model_disclosure_note: The display name does not carry the model name; the model, family, harness and generation method are declared in this file so that generation-method disclosure remains complete.
model_detail: claude-opus-5 executor subagents orchestrated by claude-fable-5 in the Claude Code harness; see multi_agent_note
